mapper.insert: insert into cm_inbox_broadcasts ( id, staff_user_id, scope, tier, mode, template_code, locale, subject_type, payload_json, target_count, success_count, failure_count ) values ( #{id}, #{staffUserId}, #{scope}, #{tier}, #{mode}, #{templateCode}, #{locale}, #{subjectType}, #{payloadJson}, 0, 0, 0 )
mapper.update: update cm_inbox_broadcasts set target_count = #{targetCount}, success_count = #{successCount}, failure_count = #{failureCount}, updated_at = current_timestamp where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select b.id, b.staff_user_id as staffUserId, b.scope, b.tier, b.mode, b.template_code as templateCode, b.locale, b.subject_type as subjectType, b.payload_json as payloadJson, b.target_count as targetCount, b.success_count as successCount, b.failure_count as failureCount, b.created_at as createdAt, b.updated_at as updatedAt, u.user_name as staffUserName from cm_inbox_broadcasts b left join sys_user u on cast(u.user_id as char) = b.staff_user_id where b.id = #{id} limit 1

select t.id, t.user_id as userId, t.message_id as messageId, t.status, t.error_message as errorMessage, t.created_at as createdAt, u.account_name as accountName from cm_inbox_broadcast_targets t left join cm_users u on u.id = t.user_id where t.broadcast_id = #{broadcastId} order by t.created_at desc, t.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into cm_inbox_single_dispatches ( id, staff_user_id, user_id, message_id, mode, template_code, locale, subject_type, subject_id, payload_json, status, error_message ) values ( #{id}, #{staffUserId}, #{userId}, null, #{mode}, #{templateCode}, #{locale}, #{subjectType}, #{subjectId}, #{payloadJson}, 'pending', null )
mapper.update: update cm_inbox_single_dispatches set message_id = #{messageId}, status = 'success', error_message = null, updated_at = current_timestamp where id = #{id}
update cm_inbox_single_dispatches set status = 'failure', error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = current_timestamp where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select d.id, d.staff_user_id as staffUserId, d.user_id as userId, d.message_id as messageId, d.mode, d.template_code as templateCode, d.locale, d.subject_type as subjectType, d.subject_id as subjectId, d.payload_json as payloadJson, d.status, d.error_message as errorMessage, d.created_at as createdAt, d.updated_at as updatedAt, u.account_name as accountName, su.user_name as staffUserName, m.body as messageBody, m.message_type as messageType from cm_inbox_single_dispatches d left join cm_users u on u.id = d.user_id left join sys_user su on cast(su.user_id as char) = d.staff_user_id left join cm_inbox_messages m on m.id = d.message_id where d.id = #{id} limit 1
